epic.title: Fitness and health: PTP restart, supplements, nutrition, rehab
epic.description:
Restart the PTP with Kirsty, settle the supplements list and the nutrition targets, save Joe's rehab sessions and the excluded lifts into Fitness, check the May logger before it is retired, and build one private owner-only habit. Health threads beyond these are not ticketed. Nothing in this epic is medical advice.

## Order
fit.01 (restart) and fit.04 (the excluded lifts) first, as the restarted plan should respect the exclusions; fit.02 and fit.03 at any time; fit.05 when the May page is found; fit.06 at any time. PW-23 (write the review for Joe PT) is linked, not recreated.

## Done means
The PTP is running again with the exclusions in place, the supplements and targets match reality, the rehab notes live in Fitness, and the private habit works for Phil only.

## Flags
None.

## Dossier
The dossier is attached in Docs: (link filled by the integrator).

## Red team
- Finding 29: Every ticket in this epic is owner-only, not only the habit.

tickets.title: Restart the PTP with Kirsty from wherever makes sense
tickets.description:
## What
A short conversation with Kirsty to choose where the PTP restarts, then one change in Fitness to match. The programme in Mycelium is `PTP, Phase 1: Restore and Stabilise` (active since 2026-W37, open-ended, five afternoon sessions Monday to Friday); no sessions were logged in the week before 2026-10-29. Options: resume Phase 1 from its first week, resume where it stopped, or move to Phase 2 using the procedure in `docs/ptp-report.md`. Also close the two loose ends the backlog carries: confirm the 15 September cutover was verified and record the week-3 review outcome (or that it did not happen). Phil and Kirsty decide; nothing here is medical advice.

## Why
H5: the PTP is paused or stopped; "a ticket to restart with Kirsty from wherever makes sense".

## Done looks like
The restart point written on this ticket; Fitness Today shows the right session on the restart day; the cutover and week-3 lines closed in the backlog.

## Unlocks
fit.03 (targets reviewed alongside the restart), fit.04 (the excluded lifts are respected in the restarted plan).

## Depends on
Nothing.

## Red team
- Finding 29: Owner-only: never on the wall, never in a shared export, not visible to any other account (the run rule for H5 health tickets).

tickets.title: One settled set of nutrition targets and the review (September's figures stand)
tickets.description:
## What
The current nutrition targets row (effective 2026-09-07) has had its review date, 28 September, pass, and the nutritionist agent reads that date on every turn. September's figures stand as the settled set (2600 kcal, 200 g protein, 80 g fat, 270 g carbs, 30 to 35 g fibre, 2.5 to 3 L water; from Kirsty's plan with Phil's protein amendment, replacing the earlier trainer's). Claude prepares a short review (the 7-day and 30-day averages against each target, body weight trend if logged); Phil, with Kirsty if he wants, keeps or adjusts each figure; Claude writes a new targets row with today's `effective_from` and a new review date Phil picks. The old row is kept, not backdated or edited. Any older hard-coded fallbacks stay fallbacks only.

## Why
H5: "one settled set of nutrition targets and the review that is due (September's figures replaced the earlier trainer's)".

## Done looks like
A new targets row exists with a future review date; the nutritionist no longer quotes a past review date; the review's figures are on this ticket.

## Unlocks
Nothing.

## Depends on
Nothing; it sits well alongside fit.01.

tickets.title: A private owner-only habit, tied to sleep
tickets.description:
## What
Build a private habit for Phil that only he can see. Phil gives the habit's name and what to record to Claude in a private session; neither appears in this ticket, its comments, commits or any report. Where it lives: an owner-only store in Phil's personal space that no direct grant or team can reach (the same handling as Finance), not a Fitness, Health or Habits row and not a ticket, because Kirsty's planned grant covers Fitness and Work. It shows only on a page Phil opens, alongside his sleep data where that exists. It never appears on the wall, on a dashboard card, in a briefing, push or digest, in the Boys' or any agent's shared context, in a shared or team export, or in the backlog export. Commit messages and reports call it "the private habit" only.

## Why
H5: an owner-only habit, never on the wall, never shared, not in any shared export.

## Done looks like
Phil can record the habit and see it beside his sleep; a second user with every grant Phil can give sees nothing; the wall, briefing, pushes, shared exports and the MYC backlog export contain nothing about it beyond this neutral title; the isolation test covers the new table.

## Unlocks
Nothing.

## Depends on
Nothing.
